basic_details.job_title: DUK Gym Trainer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Kerala University of Digital Sciences, Innovation and Technology (Digital University Kerala, DUK), Thiruvananthapuram, is preparing a panel for one post of Part time Gym Trainer, engaged on a daily wage basis as and when required, for a period of six months at a remuneration of Rs.900/- per day. Qualified Indian citizens who are certified personal trainers from a recognized institution in India, with one year of experience as a fitness trainer in the gym of a reputed educational institution, can apply online through the University's Recruitment Portal latest on 20 November 2026.

age_limit.details: Category Relaxation SC/ST 5 years OBC 3 years | Candidates should check the official notification for the complete eligibility conditions of the post.

how_to_apply: Applications for the DUK Gym Trainer post are accepted online only, and the window is open until 20 November 2026.
Open the application form on the University's careers page, https://www.duk.ac.in/careers (the Recruitment Portal).
Read the guidelines for the submission of applications given in the recruitment portal.
Fill every relevant field; anything not specifically claimed in the application against the appropriate field will not be considered at a later stage.
Upload scanned copies of the documents proving age, qualifications, experience, Medical Certificate etc. with the online application.
Submit the online application latest on 20.11.2026.
After the last date, check your registered e-mail regularly for the Test/ Interview schedule.
Original documents, to be produced as and when called for
Applications without the above documents attached will be summarily rejected, and no further chance will be given to submit them.

content_sections.heading: About DUK
content_sections.text: Kerala University of Digital Sciences, Innovation and Technology, which calls itself Digital University Kerala, is a university located at Technocity Campus, Mangalapuram, Thonnakkal PO, Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala - 695 317. This notification invites applications to prepare a panel for a Part time Gym Trainer for the University itself.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notification invites applications from qualified Indian citizens. The essential educational qualification and experience printed for the post are: Certified personal trainer from a recognized institution in India One year of experience as a fitness trainer in the gym of a reputed educational institution Age limit: The age should not exceed 40 years as on the last date for submission of application (20.11.2026). Candidates should check the official notification for the complete eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Gym Trainer is paid a remuneration of Rs.900/- per day. The appointment is on a daily wages basis for a period of six months. The notification describes the post as part time and on a daily wage basis as and when required, and the applications are for preparing a panel. The job location is Thiruvananthapuram. The notification does not mention any allowance on top of the daily remuneration.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DUK Gym Trainer (on daily wages)
content_sections.text: Applications for the DUK Gym Trainer post are accepted online only, and the window is open until 20 November 2026. Open the application form on the University's careers page, https://www.duk.ac.in/careers (the Recruitment Portal). Read the guidelines for the submission of applications given in the recruitment portal. Fill every relevant field; anything not specifically claimed in the application against the appropriate field will not be considered at a later stage. Upload scanned copies of the documents proving age, qualifications, experience, Medical Certificate etc. with the online application. Submit the online application latest on 20.11.2026. After the last date, check your registered e-mail regularly for the Test/ Interview schedule. Proof of age Proof of qualifications Proof of experience Medical Certificate Original documents, to be produced as and when called for Applications without the above documents attached will be summarily rejected, and no further chance will be given to submit them.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection for the DUK Gym Trainer post will be based on an Interview/ test. The Interview/ test will be conducted at Thiruvananthapuram only. The schedule of the Test/ Interview will be intimated to candidates through their registered email only; the notification does not give a date for it.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in DUK Gym Trainer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the post of Gym Trainer (on daily wages), and the applications are for preparing a panel.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the DUK Gym Trainer post?
faq.answer: The online application must be submitted latest on 20 November 2026; applications received after this date will be summarily rejected.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the DUK Gym Trainer post?
faq.answer: Candidates must be a certified personal trainer from a recognized institution in India and have one year of experience as a fitness trainer in the gym of a reputed educational institution.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the DUK Gym Trainer post?
faq.answer: The age should not exceed 40 years as on the last date for submission of application, with relaxation of 5 years for SC/ST and 3 years for OBC candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the DUK Gym Trainer?
faq.answer: The remuneration is Rs.900/- per day.

faq.question: Q6. Is the DUK Gym Trainer job permanent?
faq.answer: No, the appointment is on a daily wages basis for a period of six months, part time and as and when required.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the DUK Gym Trainer post?
faq.answer: Apply online through the University's Recruitment Portal, where the form is available at https://www.duk.ac.in/careers, and upload scanned copies of documents proving age, qualifications, experience and the Medical Certificate.

faq.question: Q8. How will the DUK Gym Trainer be selected?
faq.answer: Selection will be based on an Interview/ test held at Thiruvananthapuram only, and the schedule will be sent to candidates' registered email.
